apps.localizedDescription: Mangayomi is a free, open-source app for reading manga and novels and watching anime, available on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux and Windows. It supports extensions for a wide range of sources.

Mangayomi 0.9.3 | Mangayomi-v0.9.3-ios

## What's Changed
* feat: refresh the library on a schedule by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/975
* fix(player): persist completed episodes before navigation by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/979
* fix(downloads): preserve queue and select the next unread chapters by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/978
* Fixes memory and bugs where it would lag over time by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/977
* fix: keep Discord chapter presence current by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/981
* fix: decode current VOE video payloads by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/982
* fix(restore): preserve Kotatsu category assignments by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/983
* fix(player): retire native video surfaces safely by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/984
* fix(download): harden workers and HLS recovery by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/985
* fix(reader): sort local pages naturally by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/986
* fix(library): keep read titles last in unread sort by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/988
* fix(reader): make bulk read actions uniform by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/989
* fix(player): preserve shortcuts when controls hide by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/990
* fix(linux): fall back when Documents lookup fails by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/994
* Rework API Sync Server by @not-akari in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/976
* feat: redesign anime player by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/980
* Add Korean translation by @jang-geon in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1000
* feat(l10n): complete Korean translation by @Abdellox in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1004
* fix(player): preserve local file URIs by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/987
* fix(player): fall back from unsupported audio tracks by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/991
* fix(repositories): await extension repository writes by @1Selxo in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/993
